simple.meaning: אֲנָקָה (ʼănâqâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “some kind of lizard , probably the gecko (from its wail).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲנָקָה (H604) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.short: some kind of lizard , probably the gecko (from its wail)
definitions.full: H604. anaqah II. אֲנָקָה noun feminine ferret, or shrew-mouse, unclean animal Lev 11:30 (Tristr FFP 24 ; אקמתא ᵑ7 ).
